content.title: Chapter 54 - MOTOR VEHICLES AND TRAFFIC — Sec. 54-159. - Violations applied whether vehicle occupied or not.
content.summary:
A violation of any provision of this division may occur whether a vehicle is occupied
               or not.
(
Ord. No. 4561, § 2, 8-29-2016
)
